preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) > 0 for line in stdin_lines[1:]) and len([l for l in stdin_lines[1:] if l.strip()]) % 12 == 0
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 12 non-empty match description lines for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(' vs. ' in line for line in stdin_lines[1:] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each match line contains the separator ' vs. '.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(hg) <= 100 and 0 <= int(ag) <= 100 for line in stdin_lines[1:] if line.strip() for hg, ag in [(line.split(' vs. ')[0].split()[-1], line.split(' vs. ')[1].split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Goal counts for home and away teams are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(name) <= 10 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for line in stdin_lines[1:] if line.strip() for name in [line.split(' vs. ')[0].split()[0], line.split(' vs. ')[1].split()[1]])
preconditions.description: Team names are strings of length at most 10 containing only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line contains exactly two space-separated strings.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i].split()[0] != stdout_lines[i].split()[1] for i in range(len(stdout_lines)))
postconditions.description: The first and second ranked teams in each output line are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda teams, matches: sorted(teams.keys(), key=lambda t: (-teams[t]['points'], -teams[t]['gd']))[0:2] == [sorted(teams.keys(), key=lambda t: (-teams[t]['points'], -teams[t]['gd']))[0], sorted(teams.keys(), key=lambda t: (-teams[t]['points'], -teams[t]['gd']))[1]])( {t: {'points': 0, 'gd': 0} for t in set([m['home'], m['away'] for m in matches])}, [ {'home': m['home'], 'away': m['away'], 'hg': m['hg'], 'ag': m['ag']} for m in matches ] ) for matches in [ [ {'home': line.split(' vs. ')[0].split()[0], 'away': line.split(' vs. ')[1].split()[1], 'hg': int(line.split(' vs. ')[0].split()[-1]), 'ag': int(line.split(' vs. ')[1].split()[0])} for line in stdin_lines[i*12+1:(i+1)*12+1] if line.strip()] for i in range(T)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output lists the top two teams ranked by points (descending) and then by goal difference (descending), with no ties for these positions.
